name: pi-issue-tracker-typecheck
comment: The typecheck script runs `node .../typescript/bin/tsc`, not the .bin/tsc shim. This directory is shared between the host and the dev container through the bind mount, and podman machine's virtiofs presents whatever the container's npm wrote as mode 0600 — readable, but not executable. Going through node needs read permission only, so either side can run a type-check the other installed.
description: Dependency scope for `npm run typecheck`. The compiler and pi's type declarations live here rather than in the package's own node_modules for two reasons. First, the package deliberately has no install step at all — Node 24 strips TypeScript natively, so `npm test` and the extension both run straight from source — and a root node_modules would exist only to serve this one command. Second, it is 250 MB: test/container/lib.sh stages the package by copying it, and that copy has to stay cheap. tsconfig.json's `paths` points the compiler here; nothing at runtime resolves through this directory. Versions are pinned to the pi release the extension is written against.
